model_path.description: JSON file with LGSSM matrices F (dx,dx), Q (dx,dx), H (dy,dx), R (dy,dy), m0 (dx), P0 (dx,dx): x_k = F x_{k-1} + N(0,Q), y_k = H x_k + N(0,R), x_0 ~ N(m0,P0)

observations_path.description: .npz file with 'ys' of shape (T+1, dy); ys[0] is the time-0 observation ((T+1,) is accepted when dy = 1)

nparticles.description: Number of particles N (upstream LGSSM experiments use 32, tests 1000)

resampling_threshold.description: Resample when ESS < threshold * N; 1.0 (upstream default) resamples at every step, 0 never resamples

diffusion_a.description: diffusion: negative forward noising coefficient a

diffusion_T.description: diffusion: terminal time T (default 3 as experiments/lgssm; tests/test_filters.py uses 2)

diffusion_steps.description: diffusion: number of integration steps K, ts = linspace(0, T, K+1) (default 8 as experiments/lgssm; tests/test_filters.py uses 7)

diffusion_integrator.description: diffusion: integrator ('tweedie' needs ode=false, 'diffrax' needs ode=true)

diffusion_ode.description: diffusion: true = probability-flow ODE, false = reverse SDE

diffusion_jitter.description: diffusion: jitter added to the reference variance (gradient demo uses 1e-5)

ot_eps.description: ensemble_ot: entropic regulariser; null uses the upstream default 1/log(N)

ot_implicit_diff.description: ensemble_ot: implicit differentiation of Sinkhorn; default false (unrolled) as experiments/lgssm/ot.py, whereas the upstream function default and tests/test_filters.py use true; forward values are the same

soft_alpha.description: soft: softening parameter alpha in [0, 1] (1 = no softening)

prng_key.description: Optional raw PRNGKey data (two uint32 values) used instead of seed

save_particle_path.description: Also save particles and log-weights of all T+1 steps (else final step only)

compute_gradient.description: Also compute the gradient of nll w.r.t. F and H by jax.value_and_grad

compare_to_kalman.description: Also run the exact Kalman filter and compute per-step KL and Bures errors of the particle filtering moments

output_dir.description: Base output directory; a fresh subdirectory is created per call
